struct RecoveryDownload<'a> { display_name: &'a str, created: &'a str, nip05: Option<&'a str>, connect_url: Option<&'a str>, connect_qr: &'a str, nsec: &'a str, nsec_qr: &'a str, relay_url: &'a str, relay_qr: &'a str, npub: &'a str, npub_qr: &'a str, } fn download_recovery_html(sheet: RecoveryDownload<'_>) { let RecoveryDownload { display_name, created, nip05, connect_url, connect_qr, nsec, nsec_qr, relay_url, relay_qr, npub, npub_qr, } = sheet; let nip05_line = nip05 .filter(|h| !h.is_empty()) .map(|h| format!(" · {h}")) .unwrap_or_default(); let connect_section = connect_url .map(|url| { format!( r#"

📱 Sign in on your phone

Scan this code with your phone's camera — the forum opens and signs you in.

⚠ Treat this code like a key to your account.

{connect_qr}

your sign-in link

{url}
"# ) }) .unwrap_or_default(); let html = format!( r##" Recovery Sheet – {display_name}

Your account & sign-in sheet

Save this file and keep it somewhere safe — it's how you get back into your account. Everything here is private to you; don't share it.

Account: {display_name}{nip05_line} · Created {created}

{connect_section}

🔑 Your recovery key

This is the master key to your account. Anyone who reads it can sign in as you.

{nsec_qr}

recovery key (nsec)

{nsec}

📡 Server address

Only needed if you connect a separate messaging app.

{relay_qr}

address (relay)

{relay_url}

🪪 Your public profile

Safe to share — it's how people find you.

{npub_qr}

Name: {display_name}

public ID (npub)

{npub}

📖 How to restore

On your phone (easiest)

  1. Point your phone's camera at the 📱 code.
  2. The forum opens and signs you in automatically.

On a computer

  1. Open the forum's sign-in page.
  2. Paste your recovery key (the 🔑 key above).
  3. You're back in — same account.
"## );
